scope: Diagnostic traces; instrumented times do not replace the stock serving scorecard.

plow_native.method: Existing k3_trace_report critical-envelope reduction, native40-byte records,100MHz ticks. Packet body includes publish/release; recorded gates exclude initial queue claim. Private debug host driver; shipping GPU objects. Host-minus-envelope includes GPU launch tail plus host synchronization/bookkeeping, not pure CPU compute. Mixed projection includes GEMV decode prefix and MFMA prefill suffix. All3 repetitions, no timings discarded. Separate medians need not sum exactly. No memory bandwidth/spill/occupancy mechanism proven.
limitations: No hardware-counter proof of bandwidth, occupancy, or spill bottlenecks.
Ordinary one-span prefill and mixed three-span cases have different work layouts; their ratio is not a measured fusion penalty.
Prefill residual gap is unassigned timeline time, including segmented-launch gaps; it is not attributed to GPU arithmetic.
Native packet body includes publish/release overhead; initial queue claim is outside recorded gate.
Debug host driver and shipping GPU objects; timestamp envelope is validated against per-call Rust wall time.

provenance.window_rule: Directory UTC timestamp is CLI invocation start; exclusive end is next Plow CLI invocation, with final window capped at observed log EOF +1us. All36 windows account exactly for4 first-prefill outputs +508 decode row advances =512 benchmark output tokens.
provenance.attribution_limit: Mux records do not carry request IDs. Exact token accounting, nonoverlapping client windows, and recorded one-cell-at-a-time execution policy support attribution. Private18928 cancellation exercise used a separate server/log and is excluded; no pre-benchmark token records appear here.

count_units.ordinary_decode_token_advances: One logged sampled output row; batched rows/deferred-read quanta are NOT GPU launch counts
count_units.mixed_launch_events: One successful mixed_step dispatch debug event; decode_rows gives output-row advances in that dispatch
count_units.packed_prefill_events: Successful host packed-prefill advancement events; not a complete device launch census
count_units.server_tail_after_last_prefill_s: Last server decode-token log minus last prefill-token log; excludes initial prefill and is not hardware profiling

events.event: AMD mixed prefill/decode launch decode=1 prefill=3 rows=512

short_prefill_timeline.interpretation: Four fresh128-token requests cannot enter packed-prefill without initialized cursors. First ordinary prefill completes, then4 decode outputs for slot0 arrive before1 mixed dispatch processes prefixes of the other3 requests. Their final prompt tokens remain excluded from mixed and packed admission, so3 ordinary prefill completions follow serially, with deferred decode between them. Log intervals are not isolated GPU-kernel durations.

source_evidence.claim: Mixed requires active decode plus eligible pending prefill
Partial mixed advance retains original program for remaining cursor span
One pending request gets isolated prefill fallback
Ordinary decode and deferred-read multistep follow prefill
Mixed GEMM executes GEMV prefix bands followed by separate GEMM suffix with same weight pointer
Mixed gate/up similarly executes separate GEMV_GLU and GEMM_GLU weight-load streams
Multistep loops over quantum and submits one full decode step each iteration, then reads token capture once; it does not merge autoregressive forwards into one matrix pass

plow_scheduler.weight_reuse_limit: Source proves separate prefix/suffix weight-load streams, not a joint GEMM sharing one staged weight tile. It does not quantify extra HBM bytes: cache reuse may absorb some rereads. No hardware traffic measurement was made in this read-only attribution.

plow_hsa.method: Successful unmodified production server under rocprofv3 --hsa-trace --memory-copy-trace. HSA events selected by monotonic full CLI windows; stock benchmark duration excludes CLI startup. Wait intervals are unioned, not summed. Waiting includes GPU completion and copies and is not pure GPU arithmetic. Other API time is a sum, not an exclusive host timeline. Dispatch count derives one hsa_signal_add_screlease per HsaBackend::dispatch and includes helper/segmented kernels. Mixed count derives successful server debug records.
limitations: Kernel-trace mode stalls queue interposition with reused counting completion signals; its captures are invalid and excluded.
HSA-only trace cannot separately identify ordinary interpreter and helper kernel launches.
One measured cell per shape; native packet profiling supplies the three-repeat operator breakdown.

p128-c1.full_iteration_window_note: GPU kernels from this backbone start to next backbone start, including LM head and sampling after backbone; first-to-last excludes HTTP idle following last kernel. Tiny next-iteration preparation may fall in preceding window. No cross-stream CPU flow attribution used.

limits: Plow: median of three isolated shapes. vLLM: mean over serving iterations with growing context.
Projection plus activation groups Plow fused GLU and vLLM separate GELU together.
Native packet bodies include publish; gates are not all interpreter overhead. Prefill has unallocated envelope gaps.
Private host instrumentation uses shipping GPU objects and a dedicated mixed trace buffer.
Torch profiling perturbs prefill host timing. Full windows include head and sampling; small next-step preparation may enter the prior window.
Clocks/power unpinned, distinct exclusive GPU leases, shared host resources.
No hardware-counter proof of bandwidth saturation, cache misses, spill traffic or occupancy as the dominant physical cause.
BF16 only; current Plow FP8 decode is not equivalent to vLLM W8A8.

Completeness correction: 507/508 short decode iterations and94/126 long B4 iterations have the full core kernel inventory. Incomplete iterations are excluded from corrected GPU attribution, never from unprofiled serving results. Complete-subset selection may bias growing-context timing; no missing durations are imputed.

attention_shape_audit.method: Native: existing critical-envelope body reduction, three captures, 100MHz timestamps, publish/release included. vLLM: existing iteration windows and strict complete-core filter, each iteration has exactly60 attention and60 reduce records. Shape labels mapped by execution order to ordinary packet 60-layer HD sequence, not unique kernel symbols (trace omits launch shape arguments).
